purpose: Repair the proven PC-CROP AUTH_TOKEN_PEPPER_MISSING production blocker by preserving the existing root-owned opaque-token key, deriving one purpose-separated generic auth hash pepper from it, and accepting only the workflow's bounded evidence subtree while keeping every other worktree change fail-closed.
forbiddenCapabilities: secret value disclosure or repository storage
opaque root or derived pepper rotation when valid key material already exists
new opaque root creation or fallback when the protected existing opaque root file is missing
raw opaque root reuse as AUTH_TOKEN_PEPPER or derivation without the fixed pc-auth-generic-hash-pepper:v1 domain label
production host, SSH identity or protected Compose path disclosure
password reset, SMTP, IMAP, database write, deployment or container lifecycle mutation inside the provisioning workflow
acceptance: a valid legacy one-line root-owned 0600 auth key file is migrated atomically to the exact two-line contract while preserving its opaque-token root byte-for-byte
the protected opaque root file must already exist and match the active API byte-for-byte; a missing, ambiguous or mismatched authority fails closed without creating replacement key material

immediately before a legacy-file migration or a current-file pre-deploy validation, the active isolated auth database is queried through an enforced READ ONLY transaction and every persisted generic-hash state aggregate must remain zero
the active API and Web revisions must remain equal, be an ancestor of exact current main and main must remain unchanged before and after the bounded protected-file operation

runner worktree checks allow untracked files only below the exact evidence subtree created by this workflow; tracked changes, staged changes or any other untracked path fail closed before and after the remote operation

AUTH_TOKEN_PEPPER is the deterministic HMAC-SHA-256 child of the retained opaque-token root under pc-auth-generic-hash-pepper:v1 and is never printed, committed, hashed for evidence or passed through GitHub secrets
a valid current two-line file is verified without rewrite, while malformed or relationship-mismatched files fail closed

the exact full-stack release independently verifies ownership, permissions, two-line shape and derivation relationship before injection, then verifies the effective API container environment before Web rollout
only safe provision state and validity markers are published; new recurring cost remains zero
